description: E178. `reasons`: why a chain declaration, an action on a chain or an act on a chain run was refused, one closed key each, one sentence each; nothing was stored (the HTTP status of each is the service's `chains.STATUS`). `selection` (E178 s2a): the sentence of the reason `selection` for each way a chain's selection cannot be used, one for a selection that is not a well set and one for a selection that does not exist or the caller cannot read, so existence is not disclosed; `reasons.selection` is the second. `job`: the sentence an assistant's job step is refused with when it works on a chain step whose earlier steps are not closed (E151 admission, slice 2). `states`: the words a person reads for each step state. `comparisons`: the words of each comparison a condition makes. A measure's words come from the outcome rules (ophiolite.outcome-rules/1 `measures`). Placeholders are in braces; no sentence carries a code.

reasons.schema: The chain does not have the chain's shape.
reasons.label: A chain's name must read as words: letters and spaces, not an identifier.
reasons.steps: The steps do not fit together: a step can follow, be made from or depend on only earlier steps of the chain.
reasons.measure: That measure is not one the step's outcome records, or its unit does not fit it.
reasons.procedure: There is no such tool in this project.
reasons.outcome: There is no such outcome version, or it checks another kind of result than the tool makes.
reasons.outcome-moved: This chain names version {n} of "{outcome}"; version {m} is current. Revise the chain to name it.
reasons.withdrawn: This chain was withdrawn and cannot be changed or started.
reasons.label-taken: Another chain of this project already has this name.
reasons.unchanged: Nothing changed: this is the chain's current version.
reasons.disabled: This chain is turned off; turn it on before starting it.
reasons.not-due: This version is not due for this chain: it was already started or dismissed, or it is not one the chain starts for.
reasons.step-waits: This step waits for an earlier step.
reasons.not-this-kind: This cannot be done on this kind of step.
reasons.other-tool-version: This result was made by another tool version than the one this run checked.
reasons.not-from-checked-version: This result was not made from the version this run checks.
reasons.permission: You do not have the right to do this in this project.
reasons.person-only: Only a person can do this on a chain step.
reasons.not-found: There is no such chain or run in this project.
reasons.selection: The well set this chain names cannot be read: it does not exist, or you cannot open it.

selection.not-a-well-set: The selection this chain names is not a well set; name a well set.
selection.unreadable: The well set this chain names cannot be read: it does not exist, or you cannot open it.

job: This job step works on chain step "{step}", which follows "{earlier}": {state words}.

states.did-not-apply: Did not apply: the {measure words} was {read} {unit}, not {comparison words} {value} {unit}
states.undecided: Cannot be decided: the check did not record the {measure words}; a person decides
states.continued: Continued by a person despite the check
